title: Relative Langlands duality and Koszul duality
summary: Consider a pair of $S$-dual hyperspherical varieties $G\circlearrowright X$ and $G^\vee\circlearrowright X^\vee$ equipped with equivariant quantizations $Q(X)$, $Q(X^\vee)$. Assume that the local conjecture of Ben-Zvi, Sakellaridis and Venkatesh holds for this pair, and also that $X\simeq T^*_ψ(Y)$ is polarized, so that $Q(X)=D_ψ(Y)$. Let $B\subset G$ (resp. $B^\vee\subset G^\vee$) be Borel subgroups.
